headline: Chinese Stock Exchanges Ease Securities Margin Lending Rules Following Slump
summary: Stock exchanges in China are loosening margin lending rules following recent declines across domestic equity indexes. Regional peer markets in South Korea and Taiwan are also evaluating market stabilization measures.
why: Securities margin lending rules govern investor leverage and trading liquidity across domestic Chinese stock exchanges.

impacts.name: Shanghai Composite Index
impacts.why: Loosening margin trading requirements provides additional liquidity to equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory relaxation of margin lending constraints lowers leverage requirements for mainland equity buyers.
